# Said Elimam

> Portfolio of Said Elimam — an engineer, filmmaker, photographer and music composer based in Paris, France. Crafting cinematic experiences through code, lens, and sound.

Said Elimam is a multidisciplinary creative professional based in Paris who combines technical engineering expertise with artistic vision across filmmaking, photography and music composition. This site showcases his portfolio of work and provides ways to get in touch for booking and collaboration.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.saidelimam.com/): Overview of Said Elimam, featured work, skills and professional background.
- [Photography](https://www.saidelimam.com/photography): Curated gallery of stills capturing light, emotion and story, from Paris and beyond.
- [Videography](https://www.saidelimam.com/videography): Films, demo reels and music videos directed and shot by Said Elimam.
- [Discography](https://www.saidelimam.com/discography): Original music compositions and productions available to stream.
